title: PKI login step 1 — a commercial bank receives a nonce, no cookie
description: The same POST /api/v1/auth/login, for ROLE_COMMERCIAL_BANK / ROLE_TREASURY, answers 200 with a bare {"nonce": "<hex>"} and sets no cookies at all. The caller is not authenticated yet.
notes: Gateway: BCCR Central Bank gateway. This is the flow an external integrator will almost always hit, because commercial banks are the actors they build for. A fixture that stops here holds no session. Spec defect reproduced deliberately: the platform types this 200 as AuthResponse, which has no nonce property and requires accessToken/expiresIn/tokenType — a strict response validator fails this perfectly correct login. Note the absence of any Set-Cookie header.
